locations.name: Standing Buddha Statue
locations.description: A statue of the Buddha standing gracefully, often with one hand raised in a gesture of blessing or protection (abhaya mudra).

locations.name: Later Buddhism
locations.description: Later Buddhism developed new ideas about compassion and enlightenment. Mahayana Buddhism introduced the Bodhisattva, a being who delays personal enlightenment to help others.

locations.name: Early Buddhism
locations.description: Early Buddhism, also known as Theravāda, is the oldest form of Buddhism. It focuses on the original teachings of the Buddha, emphasizing self-discipline, meditation, and wisdom.
